maddeler.e:
أنعدم (form VII)
# أَنْعَدِمُ (ʔanʕadimu) /ʔan.ʕa.di.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# أَنْعَدِمَ (ʔanʕadima) /ʔan.ʕa.di.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
# أَنْعَدِمْ (ʔanʕadim) /ʔan.ʕa.dim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَدَمَ (inʕadama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
